ambiguities.source_text: To calculate the hierarchy level, count the number of pipes (|) in the employee_id_hierarchy and subtract 1
ambiguities.intent: Count pipes in employee_id_hierarchy and subtract one.

ambiguities.source_text: Find the person with the 2nd-lowest hierarchy_level within each department
ambiguities.intent: After excluding Executives and Administrator titles, select all employees at the second distinct hierarchy level in each department.

ambiguities.source_text: Parse out the dependent_team_ids for the sub-department heads
ambiguities.intent: Take index 1 of pipe-delimited dependent_team_ids as the subdepartment team ID.

ambiguities.source_text: An employee belongs to a sub-department if their `team_hierarchy` string contains the `subdept_team_id`, OR their `dependent_team_ids` string contains the `subdept_team_id`.
ambiguities.ref:
if sub_id and (sub_id in team_hierarchy or sub_id in dependent_teams):
    return sub_id
ambiguities.intent: Within the employee department, match a subdepartment team ID in team_hierarchy or dependent_team_ids.
When more than one subdepartment ID matches, use the first matching candidate as specified in full.
ambiguities.source_text: When checking multiple sub-department IDs for a department, assign the first matching one.
